claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile, set N=sum_i r_i, q=N+1, alpha=N+2, C=(1+2z) product_i((1+z)^r_i+z), d=z(1+z)^q, P=C+d, and x=min{k in N: Delta_k P<0} with zero-extended coefficients. For every natural p satisfying x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, and 2p<=alpha, with j=p-2, d[j+1]C[j]-d[j]C[j+1]>0. Thus d[j]/C[j] and d[j]/(C[j]+d[j]) strictly increase from j to j+1.
claims.scope: Universal informal lemma on the actual first-descent eligible lower-half ranks of the ordinary family. It does not assert a deletion comparison, selector consequence, selected payment, or MASS inequality; all current-p strict flags and original tag multiplicities remain as defined by the solution contract.
claims.reason: The proof uses the strict actual descent, positivity/log-concavity of C, and the strictly rising binomial d throughout the full guarded j-range. The 3p guard is included in scope though not needed by this lemma's proof.

claims.statement: For the ordinary profile (a2,a3,a4)=(10,0,0), N=20, n=33, alpha=22 and actual first strict descent x=11, the unrestricted root-mixture minor at k=4 is d[5]C[4]-d[4]C[5]=-3549105, with (d[4],d[5],C[4],C[5])=(1330,5985,27315,125586). Taking p=6,j=4 gives e0=0 and ei=0 for every arity-2 branch, but fails x+2<=p; this is not an actual eligible witness.
claims.scope: One exact finite witness against all-rank monotonicity of d[k]/(C[k]+d[k]); no claim about the guarded eligible interval or the primary payment.
claims.reason: Exact integer convolution replay. The witness rank satisfies the two numerical rank guards but not the required first-descent guard, so its scope is restricted to the unrestricted shortcut.

limitations: No universal deletion LR, selector, selected payment, MASS, or primary claim is proved.
The all-profile root-mixture lemma is informal and has no Lean or governed formal award.
Finite outputs are bounded evidence and do not independently establish the universal lemma.
